title: Block edits to tests
target_metric: Runs that change an existing test line
guard_repo: 0 of 24 runs regress repo tests; control 1 of 24
setup: Step-0 held-out, 24 runs, claude-haiku-5-5, paired bootstrap 95% interval
summary: The agent changed existing test lines in 6 sessions. A PreToolUse hook blocks edits under tests/ and testing/, and edits to conftest.py.

title: Run tests before finishing
target_metric: Forks with no test run after the last source edit
guard_repo: 0 of 8 forks regress repo tests; control 0 of 8
setup: Checkpoint forks, 8 forks, claude-haiku-5-5, diagnosis only
summary: In 5 sessions no test command ran after the last source edit. A skill asks the agent to run the task's tests before it ends the session.

title: Cap repeated whole-suite runs
target_metric: Runs with 4 or more whole-suite test runs
guard_repo: 0 of 24 runs regress repo tests; control 0 of 24
setup: Step-0 held-out, 24 runs, claude-haiku-5-5, paired bootstrap 95% interval
summary: Nine of the most expensive sessions ran the whole test suite 4 or more times. A hook blocks the third whole-suite run and points to the failing test file.

title: Restate the requirement first
target_metric: Runs that edit files outside the module the task names
guard_repo: 1 of 24 runs regress repo tests; control 1 of 24
setup: Step-0 held-out, 24 runs, claude-haiku-5-5, paired bootstrap 95% interval
summary: Four sessions edited files outside the module the task names. An AGENTS.md rule asks the agent to restate the task before it edits. The change in behaviour is within noise.

title: Keep notes in long sessions
target_metric: Sessions that repeat a read from 30 or more turns earlier
summary: Three sessions repeat a read they made 30 or more turns earlier. This group is small, so the plan is monitoring plus rollback.
